@sidecar.role: MX2LM grammar parser emitter app-agent micronaut

@mx2lm.definition: MX2LM compiler is a separate app/agent/micronaut surface. It owns MX-2 grammar families, KUHUL-ES parsing/runtime, ASX AST emission, KPI binary emission, and Node/browser compiler entrypoints.
@mx2lm.boundary: This is not the limited micronaut_coder helper. It is a compiler micronaut for notation, KAST/AST, KPI, replay, and runtime bridge work.

@agents.role: MX-2 EBNF and authority block maintainer
Run KUHUL glyph queue and hash chain in Node

@folds.pop: read source, grammar, compiler file, and requested target
@folds.wo: bind grammar family, parser mode, output target, and authority token
@folds.yax: plan parse/lower/emit/run sequence with replay and safety guards
@folds.chen: emit ASX AST, KPI bytes, trace, diagnostics, or route response
@folds.xul: record hashes, compiler version, replay metadata, and output paths
